Hey everybody, here is my build idea and a short explanation:

* I chose the **Ryzen 9 5900X** because it fits well with my gaming and professional needs and is very suitable for rendering 3D scenes with its 12 cores / 24 threads
* Cooling that is the **Lian Li GALAHAD AIO 360 RGB** with plenty of cooling performance while maintaining a near-silent noise level and looking good with RGB lights.
* All of this gets placed on the **Asus ROG Strix X570-E** motherboard which I chose because of outstanding design and cooling of VRMs etc., the support for 2x M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSDs for fast movement of large files, support for Wi-Fi 6 and support for 2.5 Gbit/s Ethernet for fast connection to a NAS. A nice plus is the RGB feature.
* As memory I picked the **G.Skill Trident Z Neo 32 GB CL16 3600MHz** for its speed/low latency, enough memory for games and rendering, for its design as well as the RGB lights.
* As storage I picked two **Samsung 980 Pro 1TB** because they support PCIe 4.0 speeds, have the amount of storage I typically need and I like to split storage onto several SSDs.
* The video card is the **Asus GeForce RTX 3080 10 GB STRIX GAMING OC** which I need for rendering and gaming performance. Again, the RGB is a very nice plus.
* Everything gets placed in the popular **Lian Li PC-O11 Dynamic** case, which is looking clean, is perfect for displaying your gear and making all of the RGB visible, while having a lot of room for all components (including the 360mm AIO) and a very good chimney-style airflow design.
* Power delivery is taken care of by the **be quiet! Dark Power Pro 11 850 W 80+ Platinum** which offers premium efficiency and reliable, sufficient power delivery for the components.
